description: This is a C source file for a Linux kernel module related to PTM (Packet Transfer Mode) driver core functions for VR9, including proc filesystem interface for debugging and control.

methods.name: proc_file_create
methods.description: Creates proc filesystem entries for debugging interfaces.

methods.name: sb_addr_to_fpi_addr_convert
methods.description: Converts buffer addresses to FPI addresses.

methods.name: proc_write_mem
methods.description: Handles writing to the /proc driver for memory operations.

methods.name: proc_read_pp32
methods.description: Reads debug information from the PP32 cores, with different implementations based on configuration.

methods.name: proc_write_pp32
methods.description: Handles commands to control PP32 cores, such as start, stop, breakpoints, and register access.

methods.name: strincmp
methods.description: Case-insensitive string comparison with length limit.

methods.name: get_number
methods.description: Parses numeric values from command strings, supporting hex and decimal.

methods.name: ignore_space
methods.description: Skips whitespace and delimiters in command parsing.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_test_init
methods.description: Module initialization function, sets up proc entries.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_test_exit
methods.description: Module cleanup function, removes proc entries.
